name: Lightpanda
summary: Lightpanda browser, drop-in replacement for Chrome-based browsing in any AI agent - faster and lighter for tasks without graphical rendering like data retrieval. Use it via MCP server, CLI fetch, or CDP with Playwright/Puppeteer — or run/save automations as deterministic, token-free replay scripts (PandaScript) via its own agent mode.
